boundary: A: ordinary packaged renderer/native IPC/PTY; trusted pointer, key/text input, actual window size/hide/show, real project forms/menus and M8 dialogs. Public project/profile/two-task creation is baseline fixture setup; P08 creates/edits an additional project using the real UI. Own Python receiver only numbers output and reads lines, never executes input/models. Passive native event/DOM observers; no handler/store/result/CSS geometry replacement, clipboard, daily resources or external DB/server writes.
